versions.changelog:
- Initial release driving the ServiceGraph API to find, shortlist, and vet US software development firms.
- Supports search across custom software, web, mobile app, API/back-end, DevOps/cloud, system integration, and hosting-related needs.
- Automatically maps user-friendly requests to catalog filters and closest tag matches.
- Default focus: IT-services firms based in the US; excludes in-house hires, non-US firms, freelancers, and non-software/AI-specific work.
- Includes guidance on authentication, API endpoints, filter syntax, tech/vertical keyword mapping, and usage recipes.
- Defers to sibling skills for web-only, AI/ML, or marketing-specific requests.
